title: Add backend predictor logic and wire it to the existing MHT-CET form

requirements.text: Implement a backend predictor method in `backend/main.mo` that accepts the user’s percentile input, converts it to an estimated rank, and returns dummy/sample prediction results with fields `college`, `branch`, and `chance` (values like Dream/Probable/Safe).

quotes:
Now add backend logic to the existing predictor form.

Create a simple predictor function that:
1. Takes percentile input.
2. Converts it into an estimated rank.
3. Returns sample results in this format:

College | Branch | Chance
COEP | Mechanical | Dream
VJTI | IT | Probable
PCCOE | Computer | Safe

Use dummy data for now.
Just make the system functional.

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a public canister method (e.g., `predict`) callable from the frontend.
Method input includes at minimum the percentile value from the form (numeric).
Method computes and returns an `estimatedRank` derived from the percentile using a simple deterministic placeholder formula (documented in code comments).
Method returns an array/list of exactly the three dummy rows: (COEP, Mechanical, Dream), (VJTI, IT, Probable), (PCCOE, Computer, Safe).
If percentile is missing/out of range/not parseable, method returns a clear error (trap or Result-style error) rather than silently succeeding with nonsense values.

requirements.text: Wire the existing `frontend/src/pages/MhtCetPredictorFormPage.tsx` submit action to call the backend predictor method using the existing `useActor` hook, and render the returned results in the UI after submission.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the form performs a backend call instead of only `console.log`.
The page shows a loading state on submit (e.g., disable the submit button and/or show loading text) until the backend responds.
On success, the UI renders a results section containing a table with columns: College, Branch, Chance, and rows matching the backend dummy data.
The UI also displays the returned `estimatedRank` value near the results (English user-facing text).
On backend error, the UI displays an English error message without crashing and allows retrying submission.
No full page reload occurs on submit (still `preventDefault`).

requirements.text: Ensure the frontend can call the new backend method by updating the generated frontend backend bindings/types (the `backendInterface` used by `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`) to include the predictor method signature and response types.

quotes: Now add backend logic to the existing predictor form.

acceptanceCriteria: TypeScript compilation succeeds with no missing-method/type errors for the new backend call.
The actor type (`backendInterface`) includes the predictor method with correct argument and return types matching the Motoko canister interface.
The frontend code calls the backend method without any `any`-typed escape hatches for the response payload.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose existing UI components only).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not implement real cutoff ingestion, PDF parsing, or any SQLite storage in this change.
Do not implement full prediction logic based on CAP cutoffs; dummy/sample data is sufficient.
Do not add new authentication flows beyond existing Internet Identity support.
Do not add a separate results route/page unless strictly necessary; rendering results on the same page is acceptable for this request.
